Wall and Floor Tiler
APD Flooring Pty Ltd
$79,000-$86,000
 
About Us
APD Flooring Pty Ltd is a trusted name in the flooring and tiling industry, known for delivering quality workmanship on residential and commercial projects. As our client base continues to grow, we're looking for a skilled and reliable Wall and Floor Tiler to join our team.
The Role
We're seeking an experienced Wall and Floor Tiler to carry out tiling work across a variety of residential and commercial projects. You'll be responsible for preparing surfaces, laying tiles to a high standard, and ensuring every job meets our quality and safety expectations.
Key Responsibilities
• Measure, cut, and lay wall and floor tiles (ceramic, porcelain, natural stone, and mosaic)
• Prepare and level surfaces prior to tiling, including waterproofing where required
• Read and interpret plans and job specifications accurately
• Apply adhesives, grout, and sealants correctly and efficiently
• Ensure all work complies with relevant Australian Standards and workplace safety requirements
• Maintain a clean and organised worksite
• Liaise professionally with clients, site supervisors, and other trades
What We're Looking For
• Minimum 3 years' hands-on experience as a Wall and Floor Tiler or relevant trade qualification (Certificate or Certificate IV in Wall and Floor Tiling) plus 1 or 2 years working experience
• Strong attention to detail and pride in producing high-quality finishes
• Sound knowledge of waterproofing practices and Australian building codes
• Sound knowledge of the Raimondi Levelling System (RLS) to lay tiles
• Current driver's licence and reliable transport
• White Card (construction induction card)
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team
• Good communication skills and a professional, reliable attitude

The Company
Jetcrete is an Australian-owned, integrated, multidisciplinary heavy engineering and underground mining services provider to the energy, resources, infrastructure, marine and defence sectors. Our diversification enables us to operate extensively across the nation, supporting a wide range of landmark projects and providing variety and career development opportunities for our workforce.
Join the Jetcrete Team

Interpret drawings and specifications
Mark and line out formwork
Erect and dismantle formwork as instructed
Perform second fixing
Assist with steel fixing when required
Inspect and ensure formworks and temporary works are firmly secured prior to concrete pour
Complete placing of concrete
About You

Trade Qualification in Carpentry
2+ years Industrial experience in Carpentry
Previous construction experience within mining and resources (preferable)
Nationally recognised Construction Safety Awareness card (White Card)
Jetcrete + You

Our staff discount scheme gives you discounts on a range of travel, entertainment, vehicle and lifestyle choices.
